        Schedule for the Season of Lent
         
        Ash Wednesday   Wednesday, March 1
         
        Masses: 12 noon and 7 p.m., The Chapel of Mary
        Ashes will be distributed at both Masses.
         
        Lent
         
        Fridays in Lent (Except Good Friday)
         
        Exposition of the Blessed Sacrament following the noon Mass, concluding with the Via Matris (Way of Our Sorrowful Mother) and Benediction at 3 p.m., The Chapel of Mary
         
        Saturdays in Lent
         
        Sacrament of Reconciliation (Confession) 11 a.m. - 12 noon.
         
        Holy Week  
         
        Sunday, April 9
         
        Palm Sunday of the Lord's Passion, 10 a.m.
        Blessing of Palms in The Grotto Plaza, Mass in the Chapel
         
        Thursday, April 13
         
        Holy Thursday - Feast of The Lord's Supper, 7 p.m. 
        The Chapel of Mary (no noon Mass)
         
        Friday, April 14
         
        Via Matris (Way of Our Sorrowful Mother) 3 p.m.
        The Chapel of Mary
         
        Friday of the Passion of the Lord (Good Friday), 7 p.m.
        The Chapel of Mary (no noon Mass)
         
        Saturday, April 15
         
        Sacrament of Reconciliation 
        11 a.m-12 noon
        The Chapel of Mary
         
        Easter Vigil, 8:00 p.m.
        The Chapel of Mary (no other Mass today)
         
        Sunday, April 16
         
        Easter Sunday Masses at 10 a.m. and 12 Noon
        The Chapel of Mary
